source_read: Deep Blue's own ordering site https://order.deepbluerestaurants.com/ (the 'Order Online' link of www.deepbluerestaurants.com, whose Nutritional Information page sends diners there; robots.txt 'Disallow:' empty; its data host vmos2.vmos.io serves no robots file). Each of 6 shops picked as a visitor does (Market Weighton, Wetwang, Brandesburton on the 'Deep Blue North Takeaway' menu; Newmarket, Horsham, Lymington on 'Takeaway Menu'; the chain's locations page lists these plus Norwich, which takes no online orders); every category page rendered in headless Chromium, one page at a time, 2 s apart; no 401/403/429 or challenge seen.
not_verifiable: allergens (the chain's allergen page links matrices filed in 2021 that don't name today's products: link only); what each item is fried in beyond the locations page's note on beef dripping at the Yorkshire shops
notes: Extraction (tools/uk_extract/deep_blue.py with vita_mojo.py) copies the 'NNN kcal' printed on each product tile, read from the rendered page text. Second read, by a different method and path: the data answer each category page loaded (vmos2.vmos.io/catalog/categories/<id>/bundles), whose product record carries its own calories figure and a default quantity; every one of the 303 printed tiles across the 6 shops equals that figure (quantity 100 %), 0 differences. Hake Regular and Hake Large print 0 kcal at every shop (their records hold one shared 541 at quantity 0): left out, as are 7 gluten-free lines and a Fish Finger Butty that print 0 kcal at some shops. Rule for several sites: 12 products print different figures in the Yorkshire and the southern shops (Cod, Haddock, Chips (Regular), Chip Butty, Jumbo Pork Sausage, Baked Beans and 4 gluten-free versions) and are left out; 14 products shown at one shop only are left out; Senior meals offer two sizes on one tile and are left out; the Bundles category (meal deals) is skipped. Held back: Boneless Chicken Wings (4) and (6), both printed as 403 kcal; Northern Bloc Peppermint Choc Chip and Strawberries Cream 100 ml, both printed as 82 kcal, the Lemon flavour's figure, while the other dairy flavours print 204-211 (looks copied; held back after looking, never corrected).
